for each unique grade/exposure/application; when materials or specifications change Download ExcelDownload PDF **51** Checkpoints **6** Sections Once per project or material source change; re-validation annually Design Engineer, QA Manager [IS 10262:2019](https://infralens.in/code/IS-10262-2019) [IS 456:2021](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456-2000) [IS 383:2016](https://infralens.in/code/IS-383-2016) Related [📐IS 10262](https://infralens.in/code/IS-10262) [✏️Concrete Slump Slab Beam](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-slump-slab-beam) [📘Concrete Mix Ratios](https://infralens.in/handbook/concrete-mix-ratios) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. DESIGN STIPULATIONS (from Specification & IS 456) | | A1 | Target Concrete Grade (fck in MPa)
Acceptance: M25 (fck=25) \| M30 (fck=30) \| M37 (fck=37) \| M40 (fck=40) \| M45 (fck=45) \| M50 (fck=50) | Design compressive strength requirement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Exposure Condition Classification
Acceptance: Mild \| Moderate \| Severe \| Very Severe \| Extreme (affects W/C ratio & cement content) | Environmental exposure category per IS 456 Table 3 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Maximum W/C Ratio (from IS 456 Table 5)
Acceptance: M25 Mild: 0.60 \| M30 Moderate: 0.55 \| M40 Severe: 0.45 \| M50 Very Severe: 0.40 | Upper limit based on grade & exposure | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Minimum Cement Content (kg/m³ from IS 456 Table 5)
Acceptance: Mild: 300 kg/m³ \| Moderate: 330 kg/m³ \| Severe: 370 kg/m³ \| Very Severe: 415 kg/m³ | Lower limit based on durability & exposure | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A5 | Maximum Cement Content (per IS 456 Cl. 8.2.4.2)
Acceptance: 450 kg/m³ (maximum allowable) | Upper limit to avoid excessive heat, shrinkage, cracking | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A6 | Target Mean Strength (fck + 1.65×SD in MPa)
Acceptance: Calculate: fck + (1.65 × assumed standard deviation); typical SD = 3-5 MPa | Design mean strength accounting for variability | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A7 | Standard Deviation (SD in MPa)
Acceptance: Conservative: 5 MPa \| Good control: 4 MPa \| Excellent control: 3 MPa | Assumed or historical variability of concrete | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A8 | Workability Requirement
Acceptance: Very Low: 25mm \| Low: 50mm \| Medium: 100mm \| High: 150mm \| Very High: 175mm | Target slump or workability class | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. MATERIAL PROPERTIES & SELECTION | | B1 | Cement Type
Acceptance: OPC 53 Grade \| OPC 43 Grade \| PPC (Portland Pozzolana Cement) | Type of Portland cement used | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Cement Specific Gravity
Acceptance: 3.15 typical for OPC; verify with supplier if different | Density of cement solids | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Fine Aggregate (Sand) Specific Gravity
Acceptance: 2.60 to 2.65 typical (test sample for accuracy) | Density of sand solids | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Coarse Aggregate Specific Gravity
Acceptance: 2.60 to 2.70 typical; test actual material | Density of coarse aggregate (20mm/10mm nominal size) | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B5 | Fine Aggregate Water Absorption (%)
Acceptance: Typically <2% (natural sand); document actual value | Moisture absorption capacity of sand | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B6 | Coarse Aggregate Water Absorption (%)
Acceptance: Typically 0.5-2% (natural stone); document actual | Moisture absorption of coarse aggregate | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B7 | Fine Aggregate Fineness Modulus (FM)
Acceptance: Zone I (FM: 2.90-3.09) \| Zone II (FM: 3.10-3.71) \| Zone III (FM: 3.72-4.51) | Grading/fineness of sand | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B8 | Coarse Aggregate Grading Zone
Acceptance: 10mm nominal \| 20mm nominal \| 40mm nominal (select based on structural requirement) | Size category of coarse aggregate | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B9 | Maximum Nominal Size Aggregate (mm)
Acceptance: 10mm \| 20mm \| 40mm (smaller sizes for thin sections; larger for mass concrete) | Largest aggregate size in mix | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B10 | Aggregate Free Moisture Content (%)
Acceptance: Measure for batch adjustments; typical 0.5-3% | Surface moisture on aggregate at batching | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. MIX DESIGN CALCULATIONS (IS 10262 Method) | | C1 | Water Content (l/m³ from IS 10262 Table 2)
Acceptance: Based on workability & aggregate size (e.g., 100-200 l/m³ typical) | Design water-to-concrete volume ratio | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | W/C Ratio Determination
Acceptance: Satisfy both: strength requirement AND maximum W/C from IS 456 Table 5 | Select W/C based on target strength and exposure | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Cement Content Calculation (kg/m³)
Acceptance: Result must satisfy: min cement ≤ Calculated ≤ max cement (450 kg/m³) | Calculate: Cement = Water content / W/C ratio | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Coarse Aggregate Volume (from IS 10262 Table 3)
Acceptance: Based on: FM of sand, max size aggregate, W/C ratio (e.g., 0.60-0.75 m³/m³) | Volume of coarse aggregate per m³ concrete | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C5 | Coarse Aggregate Mass (kg/m³)
Acceptance: Typical: 1100-1300 kg/m³ | Convert volume to mass: Volume × Specific Gravity × 1000 | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C6 | Fine Aggregate Content (by Absolute Volume Method)
Acceptance: Volume = 1 - (Cement/3.15 + Water/1.0 + Coarse Agg/SG\_coarse) m³ | Calculate remaining volume for sand | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C7 | Fine Aggregate Mass (kg/m³)
Acceptance: Typical: 600-800 kg/m³ | Convert sand volume to mass | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C8 | Admixture Type & Dosage (if used)
Acceptance: Type (if any) \| Dosage in mL/kg of cement \| Supplier specification | Plasticizer, air-entrainment, or other chemical admixture | OK
